title: chore(dev): react business-scenario verification harness (+ drop redundant PoC)
body:
Adds `apps/console/dev/sdui-scenarios-preview` — a dev harness that renders the three new `kind:'react'` business-scenario showcase pages (inquiry-triage / account-cockpit / invoice-console, framework side) through the REAL PageRenderer against a small in-memory multi-object adapter (schema + data + $filter + CRUD), with a scenario switcher.

Browser-verified end to end: tab-filtered ListView + live counts, status workflow actions, live search, master-detail ObjectForm edit, cross-object roll-ups, KPI aggregation + re-query.

Also removes the now-redundant raw `react-page-preview` PoC (superseded by the PageRenderer-based harnesses).

Pairs with framework PR adding the scenario pages.
